meaning: signed federal obligation change on this transaction
aggregation_rule: May sum only unique transactions in a defined action-date universe; retain negative deobligations; deduplicate overlapping extracts.
official_definition: Amount of Federal government’s obligation, de-obligation, or liability, in dollars, for an award transaction.

meaning: cumulative overall-award federal obligations across actions
aggregation_rule: Repeated snapshot, not the obligation of this row. Select one appropriate vintage per award; do not sum across transaction rows.
official_definition: This is a system generated element providing the sum of all the amounts entered in the "Action Obligation" field for a particular PIID and Agency. Example: Contract has 9 Modifications under "Transaction Number" as '1' and 9 modifications with the same PIID under "Transaction Number" as '2'. The base contracts and all the modifications have "Action Obligation" as $10 each. The value for the field "Total Obligated Amount" when the either of the bases or the modification is retrieved through atom feeds will be $200 ($100 under Transaction Number 1 + $100 under Transaction Number 2). "Total Obligated Amount" is generated irrespective of the "Transaction Number" on the Awards.

meaning: overall award reported outlays
aggregation_rule: Award-level snapshot repeated across transactions/subawards, not action-date payments. Before FY2022 reporting may be incomplete. Do not add to obligations.
official_definition: Represents the total outlayed amount for a given award across time. Note that outlays have only been required to be reported since FY22 (other than for COVID-19 supplemental-funded awards, which were reported starting in FY20)

meaning: transaction contract-value field; base plus exercised options

meaning: overall award current value (base/exercised)

meaning: transaction contract-value field; base plus all options, including unexercised

official_definition: Amount of Federal government’s obligation, de-obligation, or liability, in dollars, for an award transaction.

meaning: cumulative overall-award federal obligations across actions
aggregation_rule: Repeated snapshot, not the obligation of this row. Select one appropriate vintage per award; do not sum across transaction rows.
official_definition: This is a system generated element providing the sum of all the amounts entered in the "Action Obligation" field for a particular PIID and Agency. Example: Contract has 9 Modifications under "Transaction Number" as '1' and 9 modifications with the same PIID under "Transaction Number" as '2'. The base contracts and all the modifications have "Action Obligation" as $10 each. The value for the field "Total Obligated Amount" when the either of the bases or the modification is retrieved through atom feeds will be $200 ($100 under Transaction Number 1 + $100 under Transaction Number 2). "Total Obligated Amount" is generated irrespective of the "Transaction Number" on the Awards.

meaning: overall award reported outlays

meaning: cumulative overall-award federal obligations across actions

official_definition: This is a system generated element providing the sum of all the amounts entered in the "Action Obligation" field for a particular PIID and Agency. Example: Contract has 9 Modifications under "Transaction Number" as '1' and 9 modifications with the same PIID under "Transaction Number" as '2'. The base contracts and all the modifications have "Action Obligation" as $10 each. The value for the field "Total Obligated Amount" when the either of the bases or the modification is retrieved through atom feeds will be $200 ($100 under Transaction Number 1 + $100 under Transaction Number 2). "Total Obligated Amount" is generated irrespective of the "Transaction Number" on the Awards.
